basic_details.short_information: Office of the District Programme Officer, Ambedkar Nagar (ICDS/Anganwadi Chayan Samiti) has released the Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification on 03 August 2026 on the official portal upanganwadibharti.in. A total of 107 vacancies have been announced for Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) and Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) posts through the Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026.

selection_process: The selection process is conducted entirely by the District Magistrate through a District-level Selection Committee
as per the government order dated 17 September 2025.
Chairperson: Chief Development Officer or a senior administrative officer of Additional District Magistrate rank

nominated by the District Magistrate Member Secretary: District Programme Officer of the district Member: District-level SC/ST officer nominated by the District Magistrate Member: District-level OBC officer nominated by the District Magistrate Member: A Group 'A' or 'B' woman officer posted in the district
nominated by the District Magistrate Member/Presenter: Concerned Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) of the project
A quorum of at least 4 members is mandatory for the Selection Committee meeting
and the presence of the Chairperson and District Programme Officer is compulsory. SC/ST and OBC representation in the committee is also mandatory.
For the 50% Karyakatri posts reserved for internal promotion of Sahayikas
the order of priority is:
An eligible Sahayika of the same Anganwadi centre in the same Gram Sabha/Ward with a minimum of 5 years of regular service
minimum Intermediate qualification
and age not exceeding 50 years. If not available
an eligible Sahayika from another Anganwadi centre within the same Gram Sabha/Ward
selected on merit. If the 50% quota is not filled at the project level
remaining vacancies are filled at the district level following the same 50% principle.
Where posts are filled through open (direct) recruitment
the order of preference among eligible women of the same Gram Sabha/Ward is:

Widow from a family living below the poverty line (BPL) Legally divorced or deserted woman from a BPL family Other women from a BPL family (if no widow/divorced/deserted candidate is available) If no eligible BPL candidate is available: Widow from an Above Poverty Line (APL) family Legally divorced or deserted woman from an APL family Other eligible women from an APL family
If no eligible candidate is found in the same Gram Sabha
category-wise selection is done from the concerned Nyaya Panchayat area following the same priority order.
Where more than one eligible candidate is available in the same category
a merit list is prepared using the following formula:
The percentage obtained is divided by 10 to arrive at the marks (for example

45% in Intermediate = 4.5 marks). Marks obtained in grading/CGPA systems are also converted accordingly. Calculations are done up to three decimal places without rounding off. If candidates have equal marks
preference is given to the candidate with higher age; if age is also equal
preference is given to the candidate with higher educational qualification.
Reservation for Scheduled Caste (SC)
Scheduled Tribe (ST)
and Other Backward Class (OBC) candidates is applicable as per applicable Uttar Pradesh government orders
and is applied post-wise/centre-wise as shown in the vacancy annexure.
Original certificates of selected candidates are verified by a committee comprising one Selection Committee member/District Programme Officer and the concerned CDPO. On satisfactory verification

appointment letters are issued by the District Programme Officer (the appointing authority) within 15 working days of District Magistrate's approval. A waiting list (2nd position candidates) is also prepared for each vacant centre; if the selected candidate does not join
the waiting-list candidate is considered as per seniority
subject to District Magistrate's approval. The waiting list remains valid only for 3 months (90 days) from the date of issue.
how_to_apply: Find and select the notification for Ambedkar Nagar district Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika recruitment 2026.
Register with basic details and create your login credentials, if required by the portal.
Carefully fill in all personal, educational, and category details in the online application form.
Upload self-attested, clear, and readable scanned copies of all required documents.
Cross-check every detail entered against your original documents, as no correction is possible after final submission.
Submit the form online before the last date, i.e., 24 August 2026, 12:00 midnight.
Download/save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Only online applications submitted correctly and completely through upanganwadibharti.in will be accepted; no offline application or physical document will be entertained. If any error, incorrect data, or forged/fabricated academic record is found during application or verification, the candidature will be rejected. The recruitment process for the reserved category posts may be re-advertised up to a maximum of two times at the project level if no eligible reserved-category candidate is found; if still unavailable, applications are invited again from the same Gram Sabha/Nyaya Panchayat area. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease based on the decision of the Selection Committee. Two women from the same family cannot be appointed as Karyakatri and Sahayika at the same Anganwadi centre. Vacancy details are also displayed on the notice boards of the Child Development Project Office, Block, Tehsil, Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, and the District Programme Officer's office. Selected Karyakatri/Sahayika will retire from service on completion of 62 years of age, with the service-end date fixed as 30 April of the applicable cycle.

Candidates who have passed Intermediate (10+2) can also explore more 12th Pass Government Jobs and Anganwadi Recruitment opportunities available across India. Applicants looking for more Uttar Pradesh Government Jobs can check the latest recruitment notifications released by various state departments. Candidates interested in Women Government Jobs can also explore similar opportunities under the ICDS scheme across different districts. Those searching for district-wise vacancies may also browse the latest UP Anganwadi Recruitment and ICDS Jobs matching their qualification and eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Programme Officer, Ambedkar Nagar has officially released the Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification vide Notification No. C-1021 / जि0का0अधि0/आं0बा0चयन/2026-27 dated 03 August 2026. The recruitment notification invites online applications from eligible female candidates for 107 vacancies, including 2 Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) and 105 Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) posts under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme. The notification contains complete information regarding project-wise vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, age limit, reservation, selection procedure, required documents, merit preparation, application process, and important instructions. Candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully before submitting their online application through the official portal. content_sections.heading: Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 (Project-wise)
content_sections.text: The notification lists vacancies separately for each of the 10 projects (Pariyojana) in Ambedkar Nagar district, along with a category-wise (UR/OBC/SC) split for both posts. The project-wise total vacancy figures are given below. As per the notification, at least 50% of the Karyakatri posts are to be filled through internal selection from eligible Anganwadi Sahayikas of the same Gram Sabha/Ward who have completed 5 years of regular service, meet the minimum qualification, and are not above 50 years of age. Remaining Karyakatri posts and all Sahayika posts are filled through the general online selection process described below. The complete annexure of the notification also provides a centre-wise list (Anganwadi Kendra name, 11-digit centre code, Gram Panchayat/Ward name and reservation category) for the 2 Karyakatri vacancies and the 105 Sahayika vacancies. The 2 Karyakatri vacancy centres are listed below; the full list of 105 Sahayika centre codes with GP/Ward names and reservation category is available in the official notification/PDF and on the notice boards of the Block/Tehsil/CDPO office as mentioned in the press release.

content_sections.heading: Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for both Anganwadi Karyakatri and Anganwadi Sahayika posts. Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age: 35 years Cut-off date for age calculation: 1 July 2026 The date of birth mentioned in the High School (Class 10) certificate/mark sheet will be considered valid for age calculation. Age relaxation details for any reserved category are not mentioned in the official notification. The minimum educational qualification for both Anganwadi Karyakatri and Anganwadi Sahayika posts is Intermediate (Class 12) or an equivalent qualification. Preference in selection is given as per the local Gram Sabha/Ward where the Anganwadi Kendra is located, as explained in the selection priority section below.

content_sections.heading: Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is conducted entirely by the District Magistrate through a District-level Selection Committee, as per the government order dated 17 September 2025. Chairperson: Chief Development Officer or a senior administrative officer of Additional District Magistrate rank, nominated by the District Magistrate Member Secretary: District Programme Officer of the district Member: District-level SC/ST officer nominated by the District Magistrate Member: District-level OBC officer nominated by the District Magistrate Member: A Group 'A' or 'B' woman officer posted in the district, nominated by the District Magistrate Member/Presenter: Concerned Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) of the project A quorum of at least 4 members is mandatory for the Selection Committee meeting, and the presence of the Chairperson and District Programme Officer is compulsory. SC/ST and OBC representation in the committee is also mandatory. For the 50% Karyakatri posts reserved for internal promotion of Sahayikas, the order of priority is: An eligible Sahayika of the same Anganwadi centre in the same Gram Sabha/Ward with a minimum of 5 years of regular service, minimum Intermediate qualification, and age not exceeding 50 years. If not available, an eligible Sahayika from another Anganwadi centre within the same Gram Sabha/Ward, selected on merit. If the 50% quota is not filled at the project level, remaining vacancies are filled at the district level following the same 50% principle. Where posts are filled through open (direct) recruitment, the order of preference among eligible women of the same Gram Sabha/Ward is: Widow from a family living below the poverty line (BPL) Legally divorced or deserted woman from a BPL family Other women from a BPL family (if no widow/divorced/deserted candidate is available) If no eligible BPL candidate is available: Widow from an Above Poverty Line (APL) family Legally divorced or deserted woman from an APL family Other eligible women from an APL family If no eligible candidate is found in the same Gram Sabha, category-wise selection is done from the concerned Nyaya Panchayat area following the same priority order. Where more than one eligible candidate is available in the same category, a merit list is prepared using the following formula: The percentage obtained is divided by 10 to arrive at the marks (for example, 45% in Intermediate = 4.5 marks). Marks obtained in grading/CGPA systems are also converted accordingly. Calculations are done up to three decimal places without rounding off. If candidates have equal marks, preference is given to the candidate with higher age; if age is also equal, preference is given to the candidate with higher educational qualification. Reservation for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Other Backward Class (OBC) candidates is applicable as per applicable Uttar Pradesh government orders, and is applied post-wise/centre-wise as shown in the vacancy annexure. content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload clear, self-attested scanned copies of the following documents while filling the online application, as mentioned in the notification: High School (Class 10) mark sheet/certificate (for date of birth proof) Intermediate (Class 12) mark sheet/certificate (mandatory minimum qualification) Graduation and Post-graduation mark sheets, if applicable (used for merit calculation) Online digitally signed residence (निवास) certificate issued by the concerned Tehsil Online digitally signed caste certificate issued by the concerned Tehsil (if applicable) Income certificate issued online by a competent authority, not older than 3 years from the date of application (for BPL/APL category proof) For widows: death certificate and family register extract issued/attested by the Gram Panchayat Officer or concerned Nagar Nikay For divorced/deserted women: valid legal order issued by a competent court Note: Only online applications and digitally verifiable certificates are accepted. Offline applications, documents, or forms submitted by hand or post will not be considered valid.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 24 August 2026, till 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q2. How many total posts are vacant in Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 107 posts are vacant, comprising 2 Anganwadi Karyakatri posts and 105 Anganwadi Sahayika posts across 10 projects of the district.

faq.question: Q3. Can male candidates apply for Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika posts?
faq.answer: No. As per the official notification, only female candidates are eligible to apply for these posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Ambedkar Nagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on the cut-off date, 1 July 2026

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (Class 12) or an equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only through the official portal, upanganwadibharti.in.

faq.question: Q7. How is the merit list prepared for Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika selection?
faq.answer: Merit is calculated by adding the percentage marks of Intermediate, Graduation, and Post-graduation (post-graduation percentage divided by 10). In case of a tie, higher age and then higher qualification are given preference.

faq.question: Q8. Can an Anganwadi Sahayika apply for the Anganwadi Karyakatri post?
faq.answer: Yes. As per the applicable government order, 50% of Karyakatri posts are filled from eligible Anganwadi Sahayikas with a minimum of 5 years of regular service, Intermediate qualification, and age not exceeding 50 years, based on merit and locality preference.
